description: The 'more terms' arm of the D-ladder q-Borel program (follow-up flagged in qbeta_dladder_qborel_leroy_resummation_probe): extend the exact ℚ(√3) bar-odd D-ladder past k=21 (ORD=63, KMAX=31) and re-measure the divergence class C, the Borel–Leroy order s*, and the dlog-Padé vs root-test singularity-estimator gap — deciding whether the k=21 estimator inconsistency is a finite-k shadow (shrinks) or structural q-Gevrey drift (persists). Result: at k=31 the class C keeps drifting (0.0774→0.0613), s* keeps drifting (0.1865→0.1594), and the relative estimator gap |ρ_dlogPadé/ρ_rootTest − 1| PERSISTS (~0.172) — structural q-Gevrey drift, no single Gevrey index. Reinforces KC22: the honest resummation is genuine Écalle acceleration / the Φ_b state integral, not any fixed-order Borel–Leroy. Adjacent: #3683 does Borel resurgence on the EVEN κ-tower (distinct object). Scope-(a) measurement; no c_k wired; no fit; no tier change.
